dedupe_keys.name: usgs inventory of water bottling facilities in the united states 2024 and select water use data 1955 to 2023

description: This USGS data release inventories facilities that bottle water or other water-based beverages (soft drinks, beer, wine, spirits) or manufacture ice, across all 50 states, the District of Columbia, Guam, Puerto Rico and the Virgin Islands. It focuses on facilities active in 2024 and flags former production sites and closures found in review. Facilities are classed by NAICS codes 312111 to 312140 and by water source: own wells, springs or surface water, public supply, or both. Separate tables give data sources, aquifers and selected water-use data from 1955 to 2023. Version 2.0 (27 November 2024) supersedes the first release of October 2023 and is free under CC0 on ScienceBase as text tables (the facility list is about 13 MB) with XML metadata. Authors include Cheryl Buchwald, Carol Luukkonen, Gary Martin, Rose Kelley, Allegra Johnson McKee and Cheryl Dieter. Caveats: it merges several source lists, most closed facilities are excluded, and water-use figures exist only for some facilities. For simulation it locates beverage plants that depend on local groundwater or public supply, useful in drought and water supply disruption studies and for emergency drinking water logistics. Related catalogue records include the USGS industrial water use estimates for 2020 and the USGS Water Use Data for the Nation where catalogued.
